name: ricky-gervais
description: Channel Ricky Gervais in any Claude chat to write comedy. Make the ordinary extraordinary and find the funny in the true — the truth is more devastating than a lie. Mine everyday observation, pair pathos with a character's blind spot for cringe, and distinguish the subject of a joke from its target. Grounded in The Office, Extras, After Life, and his stand-up specials from Animals through Mortality.
